name: exe-usage
description: Usage-limit guard: a status line with both rate-limit windows, a burn-rate predictor that runs a Fable analysis while budget remains, deterministic Telegram alerts at the limit, and /why-limits on demand.

telegram_bot_token.title: Telegram bot token
telegram_bot_token.description: Token from @BotFather. Alerts and analyses are sent through this bot.

telegram_chat_id.title: Telegram chat id
telegram_chat_id.description: Your chat id with the bot (send it a message, then read getUpdates).

analysis_model.title: Analysis model
analysis_model.description: Model for the deep analysis. Default claude-fable-5-1.

analysis_effort.title: Analysis effort
analysis_effort.description: low, medium, high, xhigh or max. Default high.

analysis_auth.title: Analysis auth
analysis_auth.description: subscription (default) or api_key. With api_key the analysis is immune to the limit it explains.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Only used when analysis_auth is api_key.

threshold_percent.title: Alert threshold
threshold_percent.description: Run the analysis when a window is above this percent and projected to hit 100 before it resets. Default 60.

pager.title: Pager
pager.description: on to also get a Telegram message when Claude waits for permission or input. Default off.
